Flying the all new Freewing F-35C RC Jet! Hear that 110mm EDF ROAR! The biggest Jet that Freewing makes is a heavy, and large bird, but it’s graceful in the sky. This is a video of my second flight ever. Love the formation lights and afterburner. The sound is fantastic. Handles a bit more sensitive and temperamental than the F-22, but still a blast to fly. Landing gear handles the grass runway like it’s absolutely nothing. Even took my Navy landings pretty well.. haha. #radiocontrol #remotecontrol #f35 #fighterjet #rchobby

Check out the details of the NEW F-35C RC Jet! The biggest RC Jet made by Freewing, with an afterburner pre installed! I think it’s safe to say this jet has my favorite sequencing doors on the retractable landing gear out of any plane I have. The landing gear feels and looks very robust. The finish on this jet is fantastic. Some parts feel lacking detail like the cock pit, but it feels durable and heavy overall. I’ve never flown an F-35, but I’m going out and doing the maiden today. Wish me luck and watch for the flight video! #radiocontrol #remotecontrol #f35 #fighterjet #rcplane

Flying an RC MH-60 Jayhawk off a frozen lake! Flywing makes the most buttery smooth GPS helicopters. This one features the LED lights, working suspension, easy to remove canopy, and has all the bells and whistles you’d want. It even has a coordinated turn mode, where you can just use the rudder and it will automatically bank to give you smooth, scale like turns. Also, it’s a show stopper in the air. Looks so dang cool #rchelicopter #rcheli #radiocontrol #remotecontrol #rchobby @Stirlingkit
